encoder.class: TargetMeanEncoder(cols, alpha) implemented in experiment script (not in src/*.py)
encoder.formula: m = (count*cat_mean + alpha*global_mean)/(count+alpha) on TRAIN FOLD ONLY; transform maps categories, unseen -> global mean
encoder.placement: Pipeline steps = [('features', TitanicFeatureEngineer()), ('targetenc', TargetMeanEncoder), ('preprocess', ColumnTransformer), ('model', RF)] so encoder sits inside outer CV folds
encoder.preprocess_variant: numeric = NUMERIC_FEATURES + encode_cols (median impute); categorical_remaining = CATEGORICAL_FEATURES minus encode_cols (most_frequent + OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore, sparse_output=False))

fold_safety: Fold safety holds because the encoder is a Pipeline stage after TitanicFeatureEngineer and before the ColumnTransformer/estimator, so outer StratifiedKFold and StratifiedGroupKFold clone and fit the entire Pipeline per fold: TargetMeanEncoder.fit(X_train_fold_engineered, y_train_fold) learns only fold-train per-category counts/means and the fold-train global mean, and transform applied to the held-out fold maps seen categories to those smoothed means and unseen categories to the fold-train global mean without ever seeing validation labels; TitanicFeatureEngineer similarly learns ticket counts on fold-train only, and imputers/one-hot are fit inside the same fold, so no target or validation-distribution information crosses the fold boundary.

No variant beats random 0.8440 (best 0.84287 < 0.8440, deltas -0.00111 to -0.00223); no variant has strictly best Brier (baseline 0.124021 best, challengers 0.12416-0.12455 worse by +0.00014 to +0.00053); all have only 1/5 fold-wins (need >=4/5; sole win is fold2 +0.01685, offset by losses on folds 0/1/4 and tie on fold3). Smoothed means do not improve RF one-hot on this split despite Title/CabinDeck sparsity hypothesis.
